propositions: Multiple production bugs resulted from store write paths that bypassed canonical git write seams by using raw git commands (add/commit/rm) instead of sanctioned transaction/event-append APIs.

A deterministic two-layer CI lint must statically flag raw git mutation verbs in Python (AST-based, intra-function variable tracking) and in workflows/shell (cwd-aware within-step tracker context detection), fail-closed on opaque argv, and accept only reasoned inline markers.

Every historical bypass site and the codebase's own write idioms (local list construction before wrapper call, opaque argv delegation through wrapper bodies) must be caught by the lint rules without external allowlist.

Inline `# raw-git-ok: <reason>` markers without mandatory reason must fail the lint; the marker semantics differ from the existing `tickets-boundary-ok` convention (write sanction vs read/layout sanction).

The authoritative inventory of seam-internal markers, store-maintenance callers, and disposable-workspace sites is produced by report-mode bootstrap, not by plan prose enumeration; all hits must be remediated or marked before enforcement is enabled.
